content:
**Teammates' in-flight SDD is visible from origin/* branches, and resume.md is read where it is written (#1201)**

What: the snapshot gains a remoteChanges section read from refs/remotes/origin/* with no fetch (ruling 2 keeps the snapshot local and read-only); the server's poller owns an async fetch (git fetch origin --no-tags --prune --no-write-fetch-head, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, 20 s timeout) plus POST /api/remotes/refresh; cards show the remote work, a Remote work panel lists branches off the board and unjoined ones, and the drawer shows up to three remote blocks below the served change. Also fixed: change-route read resume.md at the branch root while featureCheckpoint writes openspec/changes/<feature>/resume.md, so a real resume always read as missing. Learned: the git stash list is shared across every worktree, so a no-op stash followed by pop applies another session's stash; merged detection is one for-each-ref --merged=<base> (12 ms) instead of a spawn per branch; a 24-branch budget with a sha:issue memo makes a warm build exactly 2 spawns; the remotes lane must not inherit the forge lane's halt or a forge-less server never fetches; a recording git shim must skip git's global options (-C, -c, --git-dir) before reading the verb.
